title: ObjectMeta
description: Metadata common to all PlanSpec resources

name.description: Unique identifier within the namespace. Must be DNS label format: lowercase alphanumeric, may contain hyphens, max 63 chars.

namespace.description: Namespace for resource isolation. Must be DNS label format.

uid.description: System-generated unique identifier (UUID). Clients MUST NOT set this field.

resourceVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency control token. Clients MUST NOT set this field on create.

generation.description: Incremented on spec changes only. Clients MUST NOT set this field.

creationTimestamp.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the resource was created. Clients MUST NOT set this field.

deletionTimestamp.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the resource was requested for deletion. Set by server when delete is called. Clients MUST NOT set this field.

deletionGracePeriodSeconds.description: Number of seconds before the resource should be deleted. Set by server when deletion is scheduled; absent when not pending deletion. Clients MUST NOT set this field.

finalizers.description: Qualified names of finalizers that must complete before the resource can be deleted. Prevents premature garbage collection.

labels.description: Key-value pairs for selection and organization

annotations.description: Key-value pairs for tooling and extensions

ownerReferences.description: References to owning resources for cascading deletion

controller.description: If true, this is the managing controller

blockOwnerDeletion.description: If true, block owner deletion until this resource is deleted
